critical_findings.description: Double-envelope mismatch: Frontend types expect raw body = { success, data: T } but backend returns flat data (no envelope). Since callApi wraps raw response in { success: true, data: <raw> }, accessing result.data.data or result.data.success returns undefined.
critical_findings.impact: Runtime: any code accessing result.data.data or result.data.success gets undefined. Frontend types incorrectly describe the shape.
critical_findings.fix: Remove inner { success, data: T } envelope from frontend types. Change ApiResponse<{ success: boolean; data: T }> to ApiResponse<T> where T = flat backend shape.

critical_findings.description: Double-envelope mismatch + workspace header ignored: Frontend type expects { success, data: ForeshadowStats } but backend returns { total, by_state, ... } (flat). Additionally, frontend sends X-Workspace-Id header but backend foreshadowStatsEndpoint(_request) ignores the entire request - stats are global, not workspace-scoped.
critical_findings.impact: Runtime: result.data.data undefined. Workspace filtering is non-functional - stats always return global counts.
critical_findings.fix: Fix frontend type to ApiResponse<ForeshadowStats> (flat). Fix backend to read workspace from headers and scope the query.

critical_findings.description: Frontend NovelQualityCheckResult requires 'decision' field ('APPROVED'|'REVISE'|'REWRITE'|'HUMAN_REVIEW') but backend never returns it. Backend returns { status, total_score, lock_score, style_score, logic_score, actionable_feedback, suggestions }.
critical_findings.impact: Runtime: result.data.decision is always undefined. Any frontend code branching on decision will fall through to default/undefined behavior.
critical_findings.fix: Add 'decision' derivation logic to backend (e.g., derive from total_score thresholds), or add it to frontend via post-processing.

critical_findings.description: Frontend expects { success: boolean; data: T[] } envelope but backend returns bare arrays []. callApi wraps in { success: true, data: [] }, so result.data.data is undefined.
critical_findings.impact: Runtime: result.data.data undefined. Frontend code expecting .data array will fail.
critical_findings.fix: Change frontend types from ApiResponse<{ success: boolean; data: T[] }> to ApiResponse<T[]> (bare array as raw body).

critical_findings.description: Backend always returns null (unimplemented). Frontend types response as Record<string, unknown>. Accessing keys on null throws TypeError at runtime.
critical_findings.impact: Runtime TypeError when accessing any key on result.data (which is null).
critical_findings.fix: Type frontend as ApiResponse<Record<string, unknown> | null> and add null guard in consumer code.

critical_findings.description: Frontend types response as flat Array<{ id: string; name: string }> but backend wraps in { skills: [...] }. callApi produces { success: true, data: { skills: [...] } } so result.data is an object, not an array.
critical_findings.impact: Runtime: iterating result.data as array fails since it's { skills: [...] }.
critical_findings.fix: Change frontend type to ApiResponse<{ skills: Array<{ id: string; name: string }> }>.

critical_findings.description: Frontend PluginResult type { success: boolean; output: string; error?: string } is completely different from backend PluginResult { pluginId, pluginName, score, maxScore, evidence, suggestions, details }. These are unrelated shapes.
critical_findings.impact: Runtime: result.data.success is undefined, result.data.output is undefined. All expected frontend fields are missing from actual response.
critical_findings.fix: Redefine frontend PluginResult to match backend shape: { pluginId, pluginName, score, maxScore, evidence, suggestions, details }.

critical_findings.description: Frontend expects { id: string; status: string } but backend returns { id: plugin.id, name: plugin.name }. 'status' field does not exist in backend response.
critical_findings.fix: Change frontend type to { id: string; name: string } or add 'status' to backend response.

warnings.description: Frontend sends workspace via appendWorkspacePayload but backend endpoint handlers do not read body.workspace. Workspace travels to backend but has no effect.
Frontend appends workspace via appendWorkspacePayload but backend story-bible endpoints do not consume workspace from body. Data is sent but unused by backend.
Frontend sends workspace but backend endpoints do not consume it. M10 endpoints ignore workspace in body.

Frontend treats status as optional (undefined = get all). Backend defaults status to 'pending' (only get pending). Semantic mismatch: not specifying status means 'all' on frontend but 'pending' on backend.
Backend returns 'status' and 'provider' fields not in WritingHelperResponse type. Frontend expects 'stats' but backend never returns it.

Frontend sends scene_card, dimensions, quality_goals but backend does not read them. 6 backend fields (retrieval_metadata, context_budget, self_learning, quality_level, quality_mode, critical_gate_always_on) read but frontend never sends.
Backend swallows exceptions by returning qualityDefaultPayload() with 200 status and zeroed scores instead of error response. Frontend receives success=true with useless data.
Backend returns 4 undocumented top-level keys (workflow_level, workflow_level_slug, context, _contract) and workflow_info.scene_type not in frontend ChatResponse/StreamDonePayload types.
Frontend sends 'level' field but backend workflowRouteEndpoint only extracts body.task. Level is ignored.
Frontend does not send 'genre' but backend reads body.genre. Genre will always be undefined from frontend.
Backend accepts confirm_token for checkpoint restore but frontend never sends it.
Backend reads body.include_timeline (defaults false) but frontend never sends this field. Also backend lacks input validation for empty name.
Backend reads body.name but frontend never passes it. Backend falls back to empty string = all relationships.
Backend hardcodes depth_level='moderate' and suggestions=[]. Frontend types treat these as meaningful computed values.
Backend returns finalDecision, learningInsights, comparison not in MultiPassRevisionResult type. Backend reads chapter_id which frontend never sends.
Backend reads allow_llm_fallback (defaults true) which frontend never sends.
Frontend PluginInfo includes 'enabled' field but backend response does not include it. Backend only returns { id, name, version, description, dimension }.
Frontend response types are Record<string, unknown> when backend returns specific shapes with known fields.
sbGetCompleteness accepts _workspace param but does NOT call appendWorkspacePayload (unlike sibling endpoints). Inconsistent within same module.

Systemic: No frontend function has explicit error type handling for backend error shapes. All rely on generic callApi error extraction. Backend endpoints return { error: string } with status codes but frontend has no application-level error type awareness.

gaps: writing/quality (200 with zeroed scores on error)

summary.systemic_issue: Frontend types inconsistently apply { success, data: T } inner envelope. Some modules (knowledge, analysis) expect this envelope but backend returns bare data. callApi already provides the outer envelope. Correct pattern: ApiResponse<T> where T = raw backend body shape (no inner envelope).
